trickyParts: Playwright's project grep text also holds the project name 'iphone' and file paths like phone.e2e.ts, so the grep is anchored on whitespace: /(^|\s)@phone(\s|$)/.

M2's raw step list includes fixture steps without a source line (Launch browser, Create context) whose presence depends on worker restarts after a failure; only source-located pw:api/expect/test.step steps are compared.
The pod is about 3x slower than CI and three concurrent whole-project runs on 2 CPUs produce timeouts; every such failure was re-run alone and passed.
deviations: Tag syntax: the plan named the details argument test(title, { tag: '@phone' }, fn). That form made Biome re-indent every tagged test body (62 files, +9255/-8963). The tag is written in the title instead (test('... @phone', fn)), which Playwright 1.63 reads as a tag (TestCase.tags, lib/common/index.js:2752-2760) and which the anchored grep matches; the diff is 65 files, +362/-415. AGENTS.md documents the title form and why.

T7: per the architect (spec v4 and v5), no re-runs. Base = the 10 newest successful dispatch jobs already run on main; head = this pull request's one CI run; the after median is the production check's (first 5 successful main dispatch jobs after the merge).
AGENTS.md's old Phone acceptance list named 'recipient-picker bottom sheets', which no test at base covered; the new text names only what tagged tests cover.
